exposure: Presence of sonographic features of adenomyosis (e.g., asymmetrical myometrial thickening, linear striations, myometrial cysts, hyperechoic islands, irregular endometrial-myometrial junction, parallel shadowing, localized adenomyomas)
Three or more sonographic signs of adenomyosis
Five or more sonographic features of adenomyosis
outcome: Prevalence of sonographic features of adenomyosis
cohort: The study included women with intractable pain or infertility undergoing transvaginal ultrasound and laparoscopic surgery for endometriosis (study group), compared with a control group of healthy women without a previous history of endometriosis.
finding: Sonographic features of adenomyosis are more prevalent in women undergoing surgery for endometriosis compared to healthy controls, and women with five or more features had an increased risk of infertility.
